user.goal: Browse available playbooks and understand one playbook before deciding what to do next.
notice_first: a detail view describing the selected playbook
natural_next_action: read its steps and skill/tool requirements
return to the catalog or continue through an explicit load/configuration flow
success_visible_as: selection does not unexpectedly execute anything
confusion_if: selecting a row appears to run the playbook
catalog and detail selection are visually disconnected
skills and tools look like hidden implementation metadata rather than requirements
must_not_imply: CodeSleuth is a second execution controller
a playbook owns tools independently of OpenCode

entry.user_description: The Playbooks surface is open with available items visible.

trajectory.user_expects: Selecting an item changes the detail view without executing it.
The detail view explains steps and skill/tool requirements in inspect-only mode.

affordances.appears_as: read-only explanation of the selected item

implementation_mapping.authority_boundary: OpenCode retains execution and tool-routing authority
